name: Variant room facts
notes: Grey-box facts for the variant room (src/content/data/scene/variant-room.json, mw-e27.8): they gate its fact-variant spawns. Not story canon.

facts.description: The variant room's cellar has been boarded up (the example for "cellar.sealed_by_guard"): its boards spawn once this is true. Set by tools and tests until a guard does it.
The variant room's miller has been rescued: the miller (npc-hollis stands in) is there while this is true, and a crate of his things stands in his place otherwise.
